title: Pin criterion baselines for all targeted kernels
description:
Pin the current criterion baseline for every Tier A–D kernel that has a current bench at HEAD, and commit a JSON manifest mapping each kernel to its baseline name and measurement commit. This is the V0 reference against which every subsequent spiral step proves its gain.

## Background

The PPC methodology requires a stable, version-pinned baseline so before/after measurements compare against an immutable reference. The committed `target/criterion/` directory has recent runs (Apr 18–25, 2026) but no version-pinning. This task runs `cargo bench -p gf2-core --bench <kernel-bench> -- --save-baseline ppc-v0-2026-04-27` for every targeted bench and records the manifest at `dev/benchmarks/ppc-baselines.json`.

Benches to baseline: `matrix_vector` (A1), `matmul` (A2 and B3), `fp_specialized` + `fieldvec_dot_product` (A3, C3, C4, C5), `gf2m_mul_strategies` and `gf2m_wide_mul` (C1, C2), `m4rm_components` and `m4rm_profile` (B2, B3), `sparse` (D1, D2). Per spec doc § Tier B/C/D, several kernels have no dedicated bench at HEAD — those are recorded as TBD with explicit `tbd_reason` and the kernel-implementation task adds the bench before its first spiral edit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `dev/benchmarks/ppc-baselines.json` exists, valid JSON, contains an entry for every Tier A–D kernel (A1–A3, B1–B3, C1–C5, D1–D2) with `baseline_name`, `commit_hash`, `bench_target`, and `design_size_class` fields.
- [hard] All baselines exist under `target/criterion/<bench_target>/<size>/<baseline-name>/` for every kernel **whose bench exists at HEAD**. Kernels whose bench is created by their own kernel-implementation task (per spec doc § Tier B/C/D — currently B1 transpose, C4 QuadraticExt SoA, C5 CubicExt SoA, D2 Cuthill-McKee) are recorded with `baseline_name: "TBD-<id>-..."` and an explanatory `tbd_reason` field instead of a real saved baseline. **User-approved amendment 2026-04-27 (session 2, B1 in escalation: A1+B1 approved):** the original wording "All baselines exist" required pinning kernels whose bench files do not yet exist at HEAD, contradicting the spec doc's documented exceptions; the criterion is amended to match spec-doc reality.
- [hard] Re-running `cargo bench -p gf2-core --bench <bench> -- --baseline ppc-v0-2026-04-27` succeeds without modification for every kernel with a real `baseline_name` field. **User-approved amendment 2026-04-27 (session 2, A1 in escalation):** original placeholder string was `ppc-v0-2026-04-25` (date when the spec was written); the actual measurement happened 2 days later, and the baseline label tracks the measurement day, not the spec-write day. The `commit_hash` field in the manifest is the immutable reproducibility anchor.
